scope: Read-only integration of the 12 account3 normalized impact368 release-QA worker packets; score-only release proposal gate.
proposal_handling: No proposal is approval. The normalized release_ready flag gates only the bounded impact-v2 assessment and never approves headline/description copy. All hold/defer dispositions remain blocked.
url_limit: URLs are listed as supplied/carry-forward provenance. No URL fetch, reachability check, or source-claim revalidation was performed in this release-gate integration.
independent_qa: Compared all 12 normalized output key sets with manifest assignments; checked one latest matching raw terminal candidate listed in each normalized row source_files; recomputed weighted score using Decimal and ROUND_HALF_UP for scored rows with six dimensions and stored totals.
notes: Input commits are branch heads fetched from origin; worker final QA may cite earlier commits for original and supplement batches. See worker_checks and per-row source_files; source provenance is not rewritten.
release_limit: Only assessment rows with normalized release_ready true and an independently checked scored terminal row/formula are proposed eligible. Any headline/description proposal remains unapproved; no copy is released.
explicit_blocker_summary: All 347 non-ready keys are blocked by normalized holds/deferred decisions. Their row-specific unresolved facts, missing evidence, and disposition reasons are preserved in the ledger. No hold/defer is upgraded.
